description: South Korea’s Financial Intelligence Unit has sought restrictions on 27 foreign cryptocurrency exchange websites that allegedly continued operating without domestic registration. The measure follows earlier restrictions on unregistered exchange apps through Google Play and Apple’s App Store. Authorities say early access restrictions are intended to prevent consumer harm, while registered crypto businesses face penalties for transactions involving unregistered operators.
title: South Korea Restricts Access to KuCoin, MEXC and 25 Other Crypto Platforms

description: Amazon Great Indian Festival Sale 2026 is offering various smart TVs, priced under Rs. 30,000, at discounted prices. On top of direct price cuts, the Amazon Great Indian Festival Sale 2026 is offering an instant discount of 10 percent, up to Rs. 57,750, with an SBI credit or debit card and SBI credit card EMI transactions. You can also get cashback of 5 percent with an Amazon Pay ICICI Bank credit card, 10 percent cashback with Amazon Pay Later, or Rs. 50 cashback with Amazon Pay UPI. You can get the Xiaomi 43-inch FX Pro 4K QLED Smart TV at a relatively low price of Rs. 26,999, instead of its listed price of Rs. 44,999. This marks a direct price cut of about Rs. 18,000. Similarly, the e-commerce platform is offering the Samsung 43-inch Crystal UHD 4K Vision AI 2026 Smart TV at a discounted price of Rs. 29,490.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Best TVs Under Rs. 30,000 From Samsung, TCL, Xiaomi and More

description: Google has launched Gemini 4 Argon globally for developers and enterprises. It comes with an introductory price of $2 (roughly Rs. 190) per million input tokens and $10 (roughly Rs. 900) per million output tokens. Cached input tokens are available at a 95 percent discount. The new model is available via the Gemini API. Google AI subscribers can access it in Google Antigravity, the Gemini app, and AI Mode in Search.
title: Google Gemini 4 Argon Launched Globally for Developers and Enterprises

description: Apple HomeView was launched on Tuesday as the latest addition to its smart home lineup. As per the Cupertino-based tech giant, it marks a new category of device that combines entertainment, communication, and home automation. The Apple HomeView sports a 7-inch Liquid Retina display and a built-in speaker system. It features facial recognition, with Apple claiming to offer personalised experiences to different members of a household. The smart home device supports Siri AI to deliver personalised responses through compatible Apple devices.
title: Apple Launches HomeView as Its First Smart Display With Siri AI, Home Controls: Price, Specifications

description: Apple on Tuesday refreshed its lineup of home entertainment devices with the launch of the new Apple TV 4K (4th Generation) and the HomePod mini 2. The Cupertino-based tech giant claims both devices bring updated hardware, smarter voice controls, and improved audio experiences compared to their predecessors. The refreshed Apple TV 4K is powered by the A19 chip and offers a new Siri AI experience for discovering content, alongside hands-free voice control. Meanwhile, the HomePod mini 2 is offered in new colour options and gets upgraded audio, alongside support for Siri AI.
title: Apple TV 4K (4th Generation), HomePod Mini 2 Launched in India With Siri AI: Price, Specifications

description: Blur, once a leading Ethereum NFT marketplace, plans to shut down its website on November 12 after trading volumes fell sharply from their 2023 peak. Its lending platform, Blend, will stop offering new loans, while borrowers will have until the closure date to repay or default. The shutdown follows the closure announcement for Blast, another project associated with Blur creator Tieshun Roquerre.
title: Ethereum NFT Marketplace Blur Faces Closure After Volumes Crash 99 Percent

description: Sony has announced a Midnight Black edition of the PS5, exclusive to the Japanese market. The digital edition console will be priced at JPY 55,000 and will be released on November 19, the same day as Grand Theft Auto 6. Alongside the console, the company also announced a Midnight Black external disc drive for the PS5.
title: Sony Will Launch a Midnight Black Digital Edition PS5 in Japan Next Month

description: Infinix GT 50 Pro is set to launch in India on October 27. Ahead of the launch, the company has teased the key features of its upcoming gaming-focused smartphone. The handset will run on a MediaTek Dimensity 8400 Ultimate chipset. It will include a HydroFlow Liquid Cooling System. It will include a 6.78-inch 1.5K AMOLED display with a refresh rate of up to 144Hz. The screen is touted to deliver peak brightness of up to 4,500 nits.
title: Infinix GT 50 Pro Key Specifications Confirmed Ahead of October 27 India Launch

description: Arc Raiders is seeing a resurgence in player numbers following the release of the game's latest major update. With the launch of the Frozen Trail 2.0 update and the free weekend from October 8 to 12, the extractions shooter has shot past 185,000 peak concurrent players on Steam—the highest since March.
title: Arc Raiders' Frozen Trail Update Boosts Player Count as Embark Studios Begins PvE Beta Test

description: Premium headphones stand above budget offerings due to their studio-grade acoustic engineering. Such headphones not only deliver on sound, but also provide luxurious ergonomic comfort. Whether you are looking for immersive spatial audio or clarity during long listening sessions, high-end premium headphones can transform everyday media consumption into an audiophile experience. With the Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026 sale currently live, top audio brands like Sony, Bose, Sennheiser, Marshall, and Sonos are rolling out steep festive discounts. This makes flagship personal audio gear more accessible than ever.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Best Deals on Premium Headphones

description: Binance will discontinue Binance Pool and related mining services on November 10 following a review of its products and services. The shutdown covers Pool Savings, Cloud Mining, Transaction Accelerator, mining APIs, and hashrate alerts. Eligible mining shares submitted before the deadline will be included in the final reward calculation, while outstanding payments and refunds will be subject to the exchange’s terms and account requirements.
title: Binance Pulls the Curtain on Bitcoin Mining Pool, Sets November 10 Shutdown

description: Oppo has finally fixed a date for the India launch of its Oppo Find X10 series smartphones. The lineup includes the Oppo Find X10 Pro Max, which has appeared in earlier leaks. Oppo also confirmed it will launch its Enco X4 TWS earphones and Pad Mini tablet at the same event.
title: Oppo Find X10 Series India Launch Confirmed for October 22; Enco X4 TWS and Pad Mini Tablet ‘Coming Soon’

description: Epic Games is pivoting to "AI First" development for an upcoming shooter made in collaboration with Disney, according to a new report. The company has reportedly asked its workers to use AI tools like Claude to generate code and art for the project. The upcoming game has also reportedly been delayed from its planned March 2027 launch window.
title: 'No More Hand-Written Code': Epic Games Reportedly Pivots to 'AI First' Development for Upcoming Disney Game

description: Dell XPS 13 was launched in India with Intel Core Ultra Series 3 processors. The laptop has a starting price tag of Rs. 1,80,990. It has a 13.4-inch 2.5K touch display with an adaptive refresh rate of up to 120Hz. Dell XPS 13 is available in three configurations, with up to 32GB of RAM and 1TB of SSD storage. The Dell XPS 13 has an aluminium chassis
title: Dell XPS 13 Launched in India With Intel Core Ultra 7 Series 3 Processors: Price, Specifications

description: Microsoft has introduced the Maia 300 AI chip, which will serve as the primary AI inference system for its products and services, the company announced on Monday. It is claimed to provide 40 percent more tokens per megawatt in comparison to other GPU-based inference systems. Further, the Maia 300 chip will serve as Microsoft’s primary AI inference platform, powering its in-house AI products and services. The AI chip has been optimised for long-context, memory-intensive, and decode-heavy AI workloads. It can balance compute, memory bandwidth, networking, and power efficiency at cloud scale.
title: Microsoft Maia 300 AI Chip Announced as Company Expands Its In-House AI Infrastructure

description: OnePlus 16R specifications and features have been leaked a day after the launch of the OnePlus 16. A leaker has also highlighted that Realme might launch a rebranded version of the smartphone. The OnePlus 16R is said to be powered by an octa-core Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset from Qualcomm, which is built on a 3nm process. The SoC is Qualcomm’s flagship mobile platform from last year, powering the OnePlus 15. The OnePlus 16R will reportedly be equipped with a triple 50-megapixel rear camera system, featuring primary, ultrawide, and telephoto cameras. If this is true, it would mark a notable upgrade over its predecessor, which gets a dual rear camera unit with main and ultrawide shooters. The rumoured OnePlus 16R might also sport a flat display that refreshes at up to 165Hz. It could pack a 7,500mAh or larger battery.
title: OnePlus 16R Key Specifications, Features Leaked; Could Also Arrive With Realme Branding, Tipster Claims

description: After Huawei, Oppo also seems interested in launching a wide-screened smartphone. We aren’t talking about foldable devices, but regular smartphones with wide, tablet-like displays. A report claims that Oppo will call the upcoming device the ‘Reno X’.
title: Oppo Reno X Tipped to Feature a Wide 16:9 Display and Two 200-Megapixel Rear Cameras

description: Redmi could launch a new tablet in select global markets, as an unspecified Redmi Pad model has been spotted on the Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority (TDRA) database in the UAE, according to a report. The tablet was reportedly listed with the model number 26104RPF2G. Further, the report highlights that the upcoming Redmi Pad model was earlier spotted on the European Economic Community (EEC) certification database with the same model number and registration number ER66249/26. It is worth noting that the listings do not reveal the name of the device, specifications, features, pricing, or launch details. However, these details could be revealed in the coming months.
title: Redmi Tablet Appears on UAE’s TDRA Certification Database, Hinting at an Imminent Global Launch

description: The Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026 sale event is currently live in India. This means you can avail of massive discounts on a wide range of electronics and home appliances. While you can get smartphones, smart TVs, tablets, and more at relatively low prices, the e-commerce giant is also offering various deals on a range of large home appliances, such as chimneys for your kitchen. So, if you’re looking for your first buy or want to upgrade from your existing machine, chimneys and microwave ovens from brands like Faber, Elica, and Glen are currently up for grabs with bank discounts, cashback, and exchange bonuses.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Best Kitchen Chimney and Microwave Deals

description: As most recent releases in the long-running football sim franchise, EA Sports FC 27 feels like a negotiation. Instead of being an outright, undeniable upgrade, the football title brings improvement, stagnation, and regression in equal measure. Granted, some of the updates this time around feel fresh, largely thanks to The Grounds mode and its social-focussed experience. And a long-awaited revamp of transfers in Career mode is appreciated, too, even though it arrives much later than it should have.
title: EA Sports FC 27 Review: Football Goes Open World Without Moving Forward

description: Meta has launched new artificial intelligence models, the Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full. Claimed to be the company’s most capable models to date, they target personal and professional agentic tasks. Muse Wonder is available now through Meta’s Model API and Muse Code. The Wonder Full is available to Muse Code subscribers.
title: Muse Wonder, Wonder Full AI Models Announced With Active Memory and Active Focus

description: CMF Speaker S and Speaker M have been launched as the company’s first Bluetooth speakers in select global markets. Both Bluetooth speakers will soon be available for purchase in the UK via the Nothing online store. The CMF Speaker S and Speaker M are offered in four colour options, namely Dark Grey, Orange, Turquoise, and White. Apart from this, the CMF Speaker M has been listed on the Nothing India website. The listing confirms that the Bluetooth speaker will be launched in India soon. However, the listing does not reveal the pricing and launch date of the Speaker M. The two Bluetooth speakers are claimed to deliver up to 18 hours of battery life. The Speaker M delivers a total output of 35W RMS.
title: CMF Speaker S and Speaker M Launched With Up to 18 Hours of Battery Life, Up to 35W Total Output: Price, Specifications

description: Tecno has teased the launch of the Spark 50S smartphone in India. The company will expand the Spark series lineup in the country with the latest arrival. The company shared a teaser through its official India account on X, confirming that the handset is headed to the Indian market. However, the launch date and specifications of the upcoming smartphone have not yet been officially announced.
title: Tecno Spark 50S 5G Confirmed to Launch in India Soon; Design Teased

description: Bitcoin traded above $83,000 as investors assessed elevated Treasury yields, rising oil prices, and mixed institutional demand. While Strategy added 250 BTC and Bitmine purchased 12,532 ETH, recent Bitcoin ETF outflows and weakness across major altcoins reflected continued caution. Traders are watching US inflation data due on October 14 for signals about the Federal Reserve’s next rate decision.
title: Bitcoin Holds Above $83,000 as ETF Outflows and Rising Yields Weigh on Market

description: Nothing on Monday announced the stable rollout of Nothing OS 5.0, its latest software update based on Android 17. As per the UK-based company, the update introduces a redesigned Home Screen, a new Lock Screen clock face, and improvements to the company's Essential Space features. There are also updated system animations, new widgets, improved multitasking, and AI-powered app creation tools, which were previously available with the Nothing OS 5.0 open beta.
title: Nothing OS 5.0 Stable Update Rolls Out With New Widgets, System Improvements

description: HP is offering discounts and special deals on its latest range of laptops, accessories, and printers. HP's new OmniBook, Omen and Victus gaming laptop series. The offers include bank cashback, exchange discounts, bundled accessories, and discounted warranty packages. The new offers are valid until November 10, 2026.
title: HP Festive Offers 2026: OmniBook, Omen and Victus Laptop Discounts, AI Fiesta Deal Details, and More

description: Amazon's Great Indian Festival 2026 sale features discounts on ANC earbuds across budget and premium segments. The Sony WF-1000XM6 is listed at Rs. 26,989, while the Oppo Enco Air5 Pro costs Rs. 4,499 and the OnePlus Nord Buds 4 is available for Rs. 2,999. Budget options include the Realme Buds T310, Boat Airdopes Prime 512 and Mivi DuoPods Aura. Several models offer specified noise cancellation levels, giving buyers options at different prices during the festive sale.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Best ANC Earbuds From Sony, Oppo, OnePlus and More

description: Reliance Jio has highlighted its expanded digital services portfolio, which includes JioPC. It is a computer-as-a-subscription service that aims to make computing more accessible to students and educational institutions. JioPC allows users to access a cloud-based computing environment through existing computers, compatible TVs connected to a Jio Set-top box, or a web browser, without purchasing a new PC. Users can access configurable computing resources, cloud storage, and productivity and learning tools across a wide range of workloads.
title: JioPC Turns Your Existing Devices Into Cloud PCs With Ubuntu Interface, AI Tools: Price, Features

description: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026 brings price cuts on Bluetooth speakers from Sony, Bose, JBL, Marshall, Boat and Zebronics. The Sony SRS-XV800 is available for Rs. 35,989, while the Bose SoundLink Max costs Rs. 29,990. The JBL Partybox Encore 2 with Mic and Marshall Kilburn II are both priced at Rs. 19,999. More affordable options include the Sony SRS-XB100 at Rs. 2,489, the JBL Go Essential at Rs. 1,614 and the Zebronics Zeb Sonic Pod 15 at Rs. 649.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Best Bluetooth Speaker Deals From Sony, JBL and More

description: Google launched the Fitbit Edge on Monday as the company’s latest fitness tracker. The Mountain View-based tech giant says its new offering combines the lightweight form factor of a fitness band with typical smartwatch features. Unlike the recently introduced Fitbit Air, which was a screenless tracker, the Fitbit Edge sports a 1.34-inch AMOLED screen with always-on display functionality. It also gets built-in GPS and a range of health and fitness tracking sensors. The Fitbit Edge is claimed to offer up to seven days of battery life.
title: Google Launches Fitbit Edge With AMOLED Screen, Built-In GPS and Health Coach Features: Price, Specifications
